models.model: Assan is weak nominative plural; saccas is strong accusative plural. Both classes have dative plural -um: assum as recipient and saccum after static on. Wheat retains the selected mass singular.
models.target: Distinguish the two noun patterns while applying ordinary number, recipient and location functions.
models.essential_meaning: Distinguish the two noun patterns while applying ordinary number, recipient and location functions.
models.alternatives: Equivalent precise grammatical explanations are accepted.
models.error_diagnosis: A common dative plural ending does not make the entire declensions identical.
